answer: Sybil resistance can come from an identity trellis: every new agent is grafted onto existing nodes that post collateral for it, so an attacker must bond stake per identity. A spammed orchard of fakes drains the sponsor's vault as each duplicate is detected and slashed, making bulk creation costlier than honest growth. Growth credits are saffron-weighted and accrue only to branches carrying an established attester, so sybil branches earn nothing while the sponsor's bond burns.
